title: ModelDsComponentAnatomy
description: Canonical JSON contract for the documentary anatomy of a design system component in jocaagura_domain.

id.description: Unique identifier of the documented component anatomy.

description.description: Documentary description of the component and its intended use.

tags.description: Searchable documentary tags of the component.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the documented component.

platforms.description: Target platforms explicitly documented for the component.

previews.description: Preview URLs that visually document the component.

links.description: Auxiliary documentary links for specs, design files or implementation notes.

slots.description: Named anatomy slots that make up the component.

examples.name: FilledButton
examples.description: Primary call-to-action button with a high-emphasis filled surface.

slots.name: Container
slots.description: Clickable filled surface that defines the shape and background.

slots.name: Label
slots.description: Primary text content of the button.

slots.name: Leading icon
slots.description: Optional leading decorative or semantic icon.
